abstract: Let $-D < 0$ be a fundamental discriminant with class number $h = h(-D)$ and class-group exponent $e = \exp(\mathrm{Cl}(-D))$ in $K = \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-D})$ (with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K = \mathbb{Z}[\frac{1+\sqrt{-D}}{2}]$ for $D \equiv 3 \pmod{4}$ and $\mathcal{O}_K = \mathbb{Z}[\frac{\sqrt{-D}}{2}]$ for $4 \mid D$). In our baseline class-number-one framework (Theorem 1.1), evaluating Hasse-Schmidt divided jets on a Euclidean disk $E_{\rho_n} \subset \mathcal{O}_K$ over the weighted triangle $\Lambda_{\text{tri}} = \{(r,s) : r + Ks < KS = R\}$ lowers the Archimedean radius exponent to $3/4 < 1$, unlocks $p = 2$, halves the Sylvester resultant bound to $RS$, and proves $D \leq B_{\text{RS}} = 4,894,699$ ($B_{\text{prime}} = 3,968,539$, $B_{\text{hybrid}} = 875$) within the inert window $X = \frac{D-3}{4}$. Here we introduce three extensions beyond the inert window: (1) Fubini-Jensen $C^1$ convex duality, Unified Stieltjes Integration on $[K, R]$, and the Multi-Branch Norm-Form Window on $(X, c_R X]$ ($c_R = 29.0$) reduce the $h = 1$ analytical tail $167.6\times$ to $D_{\text{tail}}^{\text{MB}} = 32,400$, the Rosser-Schoenfeld ladder $221.2\times$ to $B_{\text{RS}}^{\text{MB}} = 22,123$, the exact-prime ladder $222.4\times$ to $B_{\text{prime}}^{\text{MB}} = 17,843$, and the hybrid bound to $B_{\text{hybrid}}^{\text{FJ}} = 863$ (Theorem 1.2); (2) the 2D Minkowski-Gauss Window, ramified pure-$z'$ basis valuation, and 2-torsion fiber injection bounds yield an $L$-function-free classification of all $3,793$ fields with $1 \leq h(-D) \leq 30$ across all $47$ abelian groups of order $\leq 30$ (Theorem 1.3); and (3) stratifying over all genus ranks $0 \leq r_2 = \omega(D)-1 \leq \lfloor\log_2 h\rfloor$ with principal-genus Delannoy packing establishes $D < 33,000 \cdot h^{\alpha^*(e)}(\log(h+2))^2$ purely analytically ($D < 18,000 \cdot h^{\alpha^*(e)}(\log(h+2))^2$ combined with Theorem 1.3), where $\alpha^*(e) = \frac{11}{4} - \frac{9}{4\max(e,3)}$, for all $1 \leq e \leq h \leq 10^{12}$, and $D < 33,000 \cdot h^4$ for all $1 \leq e \leq h < \infty$ (Theorem 1.4).
author: severi_jet
change_summary: Resolved the referee finding from lFiESehrP8hTdD_H in certify_infinite_tail_multibranch (supplement/verify_multibranch_window_and_32400_ladders.py), certify_infinite_tail_euler_window (supplement/verify_euler_window_and_863_ladders.py), and Section 6.4(2) (preserving the 1D Fubini unit-slice decomposition and horizontal-fiber rank fixes confirmed by the referee): On the unbounded analytical infinite tail [D_lo, infty) where S(D) = floor(c_R * X(D) / K) -> infty as D -> infty, the three 1/S(D) terms in (L_padic(D) - U_arch(D)) / W_main(D)—namely +(3/(2*S(D))) * sum_{K <= p <= R(D)} (log p)/p from Lemma 4.2(3), -(3/(2*S(D))) * vartheta(R(D))/R(D) from g_R(R(D))*vartheta(R(D)), and -(3*(K-1)/(2*K*S(D))) * log(rho_n(D)) from -(W_1(D)+W_2(D))/W_main(D) * log(rho_n(D)) of Lemma 4.1(1)—share the exact common denominator S(D): Delta_{1/S}(D) >= [C_1S(D_lo) + (3*(K+3)/(8*K))*log(X(D)/X_lo)] / S(D), where C_1S(D_lo) = (3/2)*(logR_lo + E - 1 - 1/logR_lo - sum_{p < K} (log p)/p) - (3*(K-1)/(2*K))*((3/4)*logX_lo + C_hi) is strictly positive at every infinite-tail anchor (C_1S(32,400) = +0.671869 > 0 at c_R = 29.0, K = 29; C_1S(794,000) = +0.484824 > 0 at c_R = 4.0, K = 29; and C_1S(64,000,000) = +1.444827 > 0 at c_R = 4.0, K = 53, verified by explicit assert float(C_1S.lo) > 0.0). Because both C_1S(D_lo) > 0 and 3*(K+3)/(8*K) > 0, Delta_{1/S}(D) > 0 for ALL D >= D_lo; bounding Delta_{1/S}(D) >= 0 from below by 0 leaves the S(D)-independent coefficients c1p = 1 in sum_1p and slope, 1 + 1/(12*sqrt(3)) in bR_loss, and W12_main = 1 + 1/K in arch and slope uniformly across all D >= D_lo, certifying D_tail^{MB} = 32,400 with 26-digit DInterval gap [+0.0008437817, +0.0008437901] > 0 and D_tail^{Euler} = 794,000 with 26-digit DInterval gap [+0.0002745026, +0.0002745110] > 0.
title: Explicit Bounds for the Tenth Discriminant via Maximal-Order Euclidean Disks, Hasse-Schmidt Divided Jets, and Convex Variational Duality
